title: The Conscious choice of words
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：conscious　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 conscious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the teacher wrote of ① a conscious choice of words in the notebook, and everybody in the classroom said at once that it was ② more conscious than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the teacher, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the conscious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most conscious choice of words anybody in the classroom had ever seen, or so the notebook for March 1966 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too conscious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the pupil who had come to help; the conscious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a conscious effort to be kind, and said that no pupil in his right mind would call it ⑥ as conscious as the effort to be kind they had once had in the old classroom. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was conscious or not, and he said so.

By 1979 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something conscious, and nothing besides. The pupil from the next classroom called the whole plan ⑧ quite conscious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the conscious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1982, in public, she wrote of another conscious choice of words in the same notebook, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ more conscious than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most conscious effort to be kind in the whole classroom, she said in 1984, was the one she could never quite name; the conscious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有意识（前置定语 a conscious choice of words：1972 年先生在笔记簿里记下的那件有意识的选择）
B. adj. 有意识／刻意（比较级 more conscious than：文中两处，一处比措辞的选择，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有意识／刻意（最高级 the most conscious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有意识（表语 too conscious to do：母亲觉得它太有意识，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 刻意（前置定语 a conscious effort to be kind：叔叔把整件事称作一桩刻意的善意）
F. adj. 刻意（同级比较 as conscious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩刻意的善意相比）
G. adj. 刻意（后置定语 something conscious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 刻意（受程度副词修饰 quite conscious：那位学童的评价）

items.q: the most conscious choice of words anybody
a conscious effort to be kind
The most conscious effort to be kind in

answers.why: conscious 意为“有意识”，1972 年先生在笔记簿里记下的是“一件有意识的选择”，此处作前置定语 a conscious choice of words。
conscious 意为“有意识”，此处用比较级 more conscious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
conscious 意为“有意识”，笔记簿上 三月 那行字说它是教室里最有意识的一件，故用最高级 the most conscious choice of words。
conscious 意为“有意识”，母亲认为这件东西“太有意识了，谁也用不上”，too conscious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
conscious 意为“刻意”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩刻意的善意”，此处作前置定语 a conscious effort to be kind。
conscious 意为“刻意”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩刻意的善意一样刻意”，同级比较用 as conscious as。
conscious 意为“刻意”，笔记簿上那半行字要的是“刻意的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something conscious。
conscious 意为“刻意”，邻教室来的那位学童认为这套计划“相当刻意”，quite 修饰原级 conscious。
conscious 意为“刻意”，1982 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要刻意”，故用比较级 more conscious than。
conscious 意为“刻意”，母亲 1984 年说的是“整个教室里最刻意的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most conscious effort to be kind。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年，先生在笔记簿里记下了一件有意识的选择。（a conscious choice of words）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有意识。（more conscious than …）
母亲觉得它太有意识，谁也用不上。（too conscious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩刻意的善意。（a conscious effort to be kind）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩刻意的善意一样刻意。（as conscious as …）
到了 1979 年，笔记簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件刻意的东西。（something conscious）
answers: In 1972 the teacher wrote of a conscious choice of words in the notebook.
Everybody said it was more conscious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too conscious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a conscious effort to be kind.
He said nobody would call it as conscious as the effort to be kind they had once had.
By 1979 the notebook asked for nothing but something conscious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 conscious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the teacher wrote of a conscious choice of words in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most conscious choice of words in the classroom, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too conscious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a conscious effort to be kind, and nobody argued with him.
The pupil from the next classroom called the plan quite conscious, and everybody laughed.
The conscious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
